csv_scope_of_work: The Central Contra Costa Transit Authority ( County Connection") intends to engage the services of a transportation planning firm, herein referred to as Consultant to provide oncall multidisciplinary operations and capital planning support services for various projects associated with County Connection public transportation system. Professional services to be provided by Consultant under the Agreement and individual Work Orders may include, but may not be limited to, the tasks and activities in the following general categories: A. Public transportation operations and capital planning B. Tasks related to FTA compliance; Title VI analysis for service changes, Public Outreach Plan, Transit Asset Management Planning C. Coordination with state, federal, and local agencies D. Evaluation of alternative modes of service including taxi scrip, TNC s, and deviated routes E. Bus stop access planning F. Modeling/data analysis; GIS/web mapping G. Route Scheduling and Runcutting H. Public outreach and surveys I. Technology services J. Other related planning activities
